model: Maverick II Packaged Rooftop Unit Controller (MicroTech II MPS)
applies_to: Daikin McQuay Maverick II (MPS) packaged commercial rooftop units with the MicroTech II MPS unit controller, DAC or SCC control, application software 1.10 and later.
summary: The MicroTech II MPS controller on Maverick II rooftop units talks BACnet IP, BACnet Ethernet or BACnet MS/TP through a MicroTech II communication module (LonWorks is the other option). The table covers unit status, application and occupancy commands, occupied/unoccupied setpoints, discharge air and duct and building static pressure control, network sensor inputs, cool/heat/economizer enables and alarm read and clear. Several network inputs are guarded by a receive heartbeat.
notes: Object names are the short codes from the guide's full BACnet references (MTIIUC_MPS#########.Name); the point table itself prints longer property names, used here as descriptions.
Points marked N/A for SCC (zone control) only apply to DAC (discharge air control) units, e.g. duct static pressure and discharge air cooling setpoints.
Effective Setpoint Output AV 12 is printed twice in the table (cooling and heating rows); it is one object.
The detail page for Current Alarm shows no instance; the alarm section of the guide names it AV 1019.
Local Space Temperature (AV 17) and Local OA Temperature (AV 16) have no type or instance in the summary table; they come from their detail pages.
BACnet Ethernet is also offered as a module option.

source.title: MicroTech II McQuay Maverick II Rooftop Unit Controller Protocol Information, BACnet Networks, LonWorks Networks

integration.summary: Set Control Mode to AUTO and the network Type at the keypad. Turn the unit on and off with Application Mode (or shut it down with Emergency Override), schedule it with the occupancy scheduler input, write the setpoints and keep the heartbeat-guarded inputs refreshed. Read unit status, temperatures and the current alarm number.

minimum_points.name: ApplicCmd
minimum_points.why: Off / heat only / cool only / fan only / auto

minimum_points.name: OccState
minimum_points.why: Occupancy schedule state from the BMS

integration.enable: At the keypad (password 4545) set Control Mode to AUTO and Network Config Type to the BACnet network in use. Application Mode (MV 1002) then switches the unit off or between auto, heat only, cool only and fan only; it has no effect unless Control Mode is Auto. Emergency Override (AV 1003) = 4 shuts the unit down from the network. For network scheduling set Occupancy Mode to Auto at the keypad and write the occupancy scheduler input.
integration.heartbeat: Receive Heartbeat (AV 5, default 30 s; 0 keeps network values after a comm loss, which Daikin advises against) guards the occupancy scheduler input, application mode, building static pressure, fan capacity, space and outdoor temperature, IAQ and the cool/heat/economizer enable inputs. If they are not rewritten in time they revert to the sensor value, normal operation or, for some, keep the last value until power is cycled.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature Input (AV 4), Outdoor Air Temperature Input (AV 3), Building Static Pressure Input (AV 1005) and Space IAQ Input (AV 1010) take BMS values; Effective values (AV 15, 13, 1020, 1031) show what the unit uses. Keep writing them within the heartbeat time.
setup: Defaults: device instance 3001; BACnet IP 172.16.5.8 /16, UDP 47808, router 0.0.0.0; BACnet MS/TP MAC 0, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1.
Device object name is MTIIUC_MPS plus the device instance; the alpha part and the UDP port change only with the BACnet Communication Module Configuration Tool (UM 855).
Network parameters are set from the keypad Network Config menu (password 4545).
gotchas: Alarm AV 1019 shows only the highest-priority active alarm: 1-99 warning, 100-199 problem, 200-255 fault.
Clear one alarm by writing its number to AV 1029 (e.g. 250 for an emergency fault).
Some network inputs keep their last value after the heartbeat expires until power is cycled; send them again after a restart.
